measures.gross_sales_v1: Completed-order quantity times unit price; excludes tax and freight.
measures.refunds_v1: Posted refunds before the exclusive as-of cutoff, attributed to the original order month.
measures.net_sales_v1: Gross sales minus line-total discounts minus posted cohort refunds.

grain_warning: Aggregate order_lines and refunds separately by order_id before joining; SUM(DISTINCT amount) loses equal-valued real rows.
